test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by Two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pinks are black.

Some blue are pink.

**Conclusions:**

I. All blue are black.

II. All pink are black.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Either conclusion I or II follows.

solution:
Given Statements:

Some pinks are black.

Some blue are pink.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c4439cadd3f95d99cb0e10880d89fd7e810283a4ce8805b77e4679807d887de.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All blue are black - False (Because, No definite relation given between Blue and Black, so it can be possible only).

II. All pink are black - False (Because, Some pinks are black, and the remaining part will be possible only).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
